reuse.why: Extends the existing shared pre-link guard that all six providers already call; it runs its own SELECT where db.getAccount already exists, but that is the same raw-query style as the guard next to it.

duplication.why: The closed check is written once, but it fetches the upgrading account by id again although each provider fetches the same row a few lines later.

placement.why: The rule lives in accounts/link.ts, in the guard that already holds the pre-link checks, and no provider function has its own copy.

scope.why: Focused on the rule, but renaming the guard means touching all six call sites only to change its name.

maintainability.why: Any future provider that calls the guard gets both link rules, and the new name says what the guard is for.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; every provider goes through link.assertBankAccountCanBeLinked

one_place.where: accounts/link.ts assertBankAccountCanBeLinked, which the goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, fintegra, akahu and enableBanking link functions all call
